texts.li: {X_nameDef}, a hospitaller of {FACTION}, is walking the order's round of the farms and holdings, and stopped at the gate. {X_nameDef} had asked after {A_nameDef}'s {TALE} before anyone said a word about it.\n\nThe order asks nothing for its care, {X_nameDef} says, though the sickhouse at home is always short of medicine.

[lowtech] A hospitaller of {FACTION}, {X_nameDef}, has come up the road with a satchel of herbs and clean linen, on the order's round of the farms. {X_nameDef} saw {A_nameDef} favoring the {TALE} from the gate, and offers to see to it today, freely, as the order does.

[industrial|spacer] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} looked at the colony's medicine with polite interest and opened a satchel of herbs and linen beside it. The order sends its hospitallers round the holdings every season, {X_nameDef} says, and {A_nameDef}'s {TALE} is just the thing they come for.

[ail:HeadCold|ail:ChestCold] {X_nameDef}, a hospitaller of {FACTION}, heard {A_nameDef} coughing from the road and came in to see about it. The order has a tea for that, and a poultice for the chest, and asks nothing for them.

[ail:StrainedBack] {A_nameDef} straightened up from a bucket very slowly, and {X_nameDef}, a hospitaller of {FACTION} on the order's round, saw it from the gate. {X_nameDef} has a way with backs, and offers to see to {A_nameDef}'s for nothing.

[their:grateful] The order remembers the colony kindly. {X_nameDef}, one of {FACTION}'s hospitallers, has come out of the way on the round to see how the colony does, and has already noticed {A_nameDef}'s {TALE}.

li.label: Let {X_objective} see to {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} sat {A_nameDef} down at the table and saw to the {TALE} with clean hands and a great deal of patience, and would not take a coin for it. {A_nameDef} already feels better.

outcomes.li: [ail:StrainedBack] {X_nameDef} found the knot in {A_nameDef}'s back with two thumbs and worked it loose over an hour. {A_nameDef} stood up straight for the first time in days.
[ail:HeadCold|ail:ChestCold] {X_nameDef} brewed the tea at the colony's own fire, sat with {A_nameDef} while it was drunk, and left the rest in a twist of cloth.

li.label: Send medicine back for the sickhouse (3), and let our doctor watch
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} treated {A_nameDef} with {B_nameDef} at {X_possessive} elbow the whole time, and went on down the road with three doses of the colony's medicine for the order's ward. {A_nameDef} is on the mend, and {B_nameDef} has filled a page with notes.

outcomes.li: [b:office:Physician] The colony's physician, {B_nameDef}, watched {X_nameDef} work and asked about everything twice. The order's ways are slow, {B_nameDef} says, and they work.

li.label: {A_nameDef} will mend on {A_possessive} own
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} leaves {A_nameDef} with some advice and a blessing, and goes on with the round.

texts.li: {X_nameDef}, an outrider of {FACTION}, has come up to the gate ahead of a league caravan on the road past the colony. The caravan carries more than it can sell on the road, {X_nameDef} says, and could turn aside to the colony's gate today if the colony has a mind to trade.

[lowtech] An outrider of {FACTION}, {X_nameDef}, has come up to the gate ahead of a long string of pack beasts on the road. The league's caravan could turn aside to the colony, {X_nameDef} says, if the colony wants to see what it carries.
[their:grateful] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} came on ahead of the league's caravan to the colony's gate, as the league does for a friend on its roads. The caravan will turn aside if the colony asks it.

li.label: Bid the caravan come
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is going back to the road with the colony's word, and the league's caravan is turning aside for the colony's gate.

li.label: Not this time
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} touched a hand to {X_possessive} hat and walked back to the caravan, which keeps to the road.
